page0.text:
...I'm out of breath.
I don't know where I ran, but when I realize it, I see a familiar Western-style mansion towering in front of me.

page1.text: "Shirou, over here...! Are you conscious? Can you walk?"

page2.text:
...I run, being pulled by someone.
My body is strangely light.
It must've gotten lighter after losing my insides, or did I lose my senses?
The only weight I feel is Fuji-nee's body that I'm holding with one arm.

page3.text:
I can't see well.
I'm not sure where I'm walking or what I'm doing.

page4.text: "Lay Ms. Fujimura there... Hey, are you listening, Shirou!? It's safe here, so just let go...!"

page5.text:
Someone takes away the person I'm holding.
The important weight disappears.
My body becomes heavy in return.
My body that was once light turns into iron, and I collapse, unable to even stand.

page6.text: "Ungh...! Archer, hurry...! Take him to my room so I can treat him...!"

page7.text:
I hear someone's voice.
My body is heavy and hot.
...I imagine turning red.
Does it get this hot when you put steel in fire to make a sword?
The heat gradually cools down as I pass time uselessly.

page8.text:
"..."
A room I don't know.
I look up at the ceiling with a boiling head.
...That's all I can do.
It seems like I'm lying on a bed.

page9.text: "I can't heal this wound. You probably can't fight any longer with this wound, but... You're not a Master anymore, so I guess there's no reason to fight either."

page10.text:
...A voice that has regained its calm unlike earlier.
The person who brought me here and treated my wound...
"...This is it. You don't have to fight anymore, Shirou."
...Said those words.

page11.text:
...
I try to say something and my vision turns black.
My eyelids fall.
Anesthesia puts my body to sleep.
I feel someone leaving and hear the sound of a door closing.
...
My consciousness cut out there.
